title: Resolve which FOSB measurement the EndometDB combined release represents
blocked_reason: The combined FOSB row is labeled with the HT-12 probe. Per-chip measurement provenance and a documented join from WG-6 expression columns to the native clinical assay keys remain unresolved. See docs/research-notes/GSE141549_FOSB_MEASUREMENT_2026-11-13.md.
question: Can the authors' harmonized FOSB measurement be traced to a defined probe and platform for the donor-linked endometrial assays?
scope: Methods and platform provenance, before Finnish expression analysis. Start from the existing cohort and oligo audits.
steps: Check the source-level platform assignment, probe harmonization and log scale for the native and combined releases.
Identify which donor-linked assays can supply the same measurement across clinical groups.
Report source-backed measurement eligibility or an unresolved mapping before examining outcomes.
deliverables: A source-linked measurement trace and aggregate eligibility decision; no participant keys or expression values in Git.
acceptance: Support each proposed cross-platform mapping with study or manufacturer evidence.
Keep overlapping run and phase counts, treatment-window uncertainty and control definitions explicit.
Do not infer participant links across releases from clinical attributes.
